issues.description: The template's GroverKakuro class initializes number_of_qubits_query_register as a float (0.0). QuantumRegister expects an integer number of qubits, so instantiating the template will raise a type/error and block students. The solution uses an integer value (4) matching the problem description (4 binary variables for a 2x2 Kakuro).
issues.suggestedFix: Change number_of_qubits_query_register in the template to an integer. For example set self.number_of_qubits_query_register = 4 (int) to match the 2x2 Kakuro description, or use an integer placeholder (e.g. 0) rather than a float so QuantumRegister is constructed with an int.
